content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
input.rationale: Article XII is a wholly one-way indemnity running from us to Licensor, covering any exercise of the licence rights, the conduct of our business and any breach by us. There is no Licensor indemnity anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "infring" return nothing else), and Article XIII goes further by stating that Licensor shall in no circumstance be liable for claims that use of the Licensed Technology results in infringement of third-party intellectual property, while the warranty disclaimer excludes non-infringement. That is the rule's walk-away scenario (no Vendor IP indemnity plus a one-way Customer indemnity), so it fails the fallback as well as the preferred position. Our redline inserts the standard Licensor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with usual notice-control-cooperation procedure, expressly outside the Article XIII cap so it has content, and narrows our own indemnity to breach of the licence restrictions, our breach of law and content we supply. We flag the IP-liability exclusion in Article XIII only as it defeats the indemnity; the cap level itself is a matter for the limitation-of-liability rule.

proposal.summary: Add Licensor (Vendor) defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct, and narrow the one-way Licensee indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XII currently runs one way only: we indemnify Licensor for essentially any use of the licensed technology, while Licensor gives us no indemnity and Article XIII expressly disclaims any Licensor liability for infringement. We have added the customary Licensor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct (carved out of the liability cap so it is meaningful) and narrowed our indemnity to our breach of the licence restrictions, our breach of law and content we supply. If helpful, we can discuss the usual IP-indemnity exclusions (our modifications, combinations and specifications) and a super-cap in place of the full carve-out.

ops.text: Licensor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Licensee and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorney's fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Licensed Technology, the Documentation or any service or deliverable provided by Licensor infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (ii) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data caused by Licensor; or (iv) Licensor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Licensor's obligations under this paragraph shall not be subject to or limited by Article XIII (Exclusion of Damages; Limitation of Liability). The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on the indemnified party shall be entered into without its prior written consent), and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense.
